name: CSS_addRule
description:
Inserts a new rule with the given `ruleText` in a stylesheet with given `styleSheetId`, at the
position specified by `location`.

styleSheetId.description: The css style sheet identifier where a new rule should be inserted.

ruleText.description: The text of a new rule.

location.description: Text position of a new rule in the target style sheet.

name: CSS_collectClassNames
description: Returns all class names from specified stylesheet.

name: CSS_createStyleSheet
description: Creates a new special "via-inspector" stylesheet in the frame with given `frameId`.

frameId.description: Identifier of the frame where "via-inspector" stylesheet should be created.

name: CSS_disable
description: Disables the CSS agent for the given page.

name: CSS_enable
description:
Enables the CSS agent for the given page. Clients should not assume that the CSS agent has been
enabled until the result of this command is received.

name: CSS_forcePseudoState
description:
Ensures that the given node will have specified pseudo-classes whenever its style is computed by
the browser.

nodeId.description: The element id for which to force the pseudo state.

forcedPseudoClasses.description: Element pseudo classes to force when computing the element's style.

name: CSS_getBackgroundColors
description: Execute CSS.getBackgroundColors

nodeId.description: Id of the node to get background colors for.

name: CSS_getComputedStyleForNode
description: Returns the computed style for a DOM node identified by `nodeId`.

name: CSS_getInlineStylesForNode
description:
Returns the styles defined inline (explicitly in the "style" attribute and implicitly, using DOM
attributes) for a DOM node identified by `nodeId`.

name: CSS_getMatchedStylesForNode
description: Returns requested styles for a DOM node identified by `nodeId`.

name: CSS_getMediaQueries
description: Returns all media queries parsed by the rendering engine.

name: CSS_getPlatformFontsForNode
description:
Requests information about platform fonts which we used to render child TextNodes in the given
node.

name: CSS_getStyleSheetText
description: Returns the current textual content for a stylesheet.

name: CSS_trackComputedStyleUpdates
description:
Starts tracking the given computed styles for updates. The specified array of properties
replaces the one previously specified. Pass empty array to disable tracking.
Use takeComputedStyleUpdates to retrieve the list of nodes that had properties modified.
The changes to computed style properties are only tracked for nodes pushed to the front-end
by the DOM agent. If no changes to the tracked properties occur after the node has been pushed
to the front-end, no updates will be issued for the node.

name: CSS_takeComputedStyleUpdates
description: Polls the next batch of computed style updates.

name: CSS_setEffectivePropertyValueForNode
description:
Find a rule with the given active property for the given node and set the new value for this
property

nodeId.description: The element id for which to set property.

name: CSS_setKeyframeKey
description: Modifies the keyframe rule key text.

name: CSS_setMediaText
description: Modifies the rule selector.

name: CSS_setRuleSelector
description: Modifies the rule selector.

name: CSS_setStyleSheetText
description: Sets the new stylesheet text.

name: CSS_setStyleTexts
description: Applies specified style edits one after another in the given order.

name: CSS_startRuleUsageTracking
description: Enables the selector recording.

name: CSS_stopRuleUsageTracking
description:
Stop tracking rule usage and return the list of rules that were used since last call to
`takeCoverageDelta` (or since start of coverage instrumentation)

name: CSS_takeCoverageDelta
description:
Obtain list of rules that became used since last call to this method (or since start of coverage
instrumentation)

name: CSS_setLocalFontsEnabled
description: Enables/disables rendering of local CSS fonts (enabled by default).

enabled.description: Whether rendering of local fonts is enabled.

name: DOM_collectClassNamesFromSubtree
description: Collects class names for the node with given id and all of it's child nodes.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to collect class names.

name: DOM_copyTo
description:
Creates a deep copy of the specified node and places it into the target container before the
given anchor.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to copy.

targetNodeId.description: Id of the element to drop the copy into.

insertBeforeNodeId.description:
Drop the copy before this node (if absent, the copy becomes the last child of
`targetNodeId`).

name: DOM_describeNode
description:
Describes node given its id, does not require domain to be enabled. Does not start tracking any
objects, can be used for automation.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

depth.description:
The maximum depth at which children should be retrieved, defaults to 1. Use -1 for the
entire subtree or provide an integer larger than 0.

pierce.description:
Whether or not iframes and shadow roots should be traversed when returning the subtree
(default is false).

name: DOM_scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
description:
Scrolls the specified rect of the given node into view if not already visible.
Note: exactly one between nodeId, backendNodeId and objectId should be passed
to identify the node.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

rect.description:
The rect to be scrolled into view, relative to the node's border box, in CSS pixels.
When omitted, center of the node will be used, similar to Element.scrollIntoView.

name: DOM_disable
description: Disables DOM agent for the given page.

name: DOM_discardSearchResults
description:
Discards search results from the session with the given id. `getSearchResults` should no longer
be called for that search.

name: DOM_enable
description: Enables DOM agent for the given page.

name: DOM_focus
description: Focuses the given element.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_getAttributes
description: Returns attributes for the specified node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to retrieve attibutes for.

name: DOM_getBoxModel
description: Returns boxes for the given node.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_getContentQuads
description:
Returns quads that describe node position on the page. This method
might return multiple quads for inline nodes.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_getDocument
description: Returns the root DOM node (and optionally the subtree) to the caller.

depth.description:
The maximum depth at which children should be retrieved, defaults to 1. Use -1 for the
entire subtree or provide an integer larger than 0.

pierce.description:
Whether or not iframes and shadow roots should be traversed when returning the subtree
(default is false).

name: DOM_getFlattenedDocument
description:
Returns the root DOM node (and optionally the subtree) to the caller.
Deprecated, as it is not designed to work well with the rest of the DOM agent.
Use DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot instead.

depth.description:
The maximum depth at which children should be retrieved, defaults to 1. Use -1 for the
entire subtree or provide an integer larger than 0.

pierce.description:
Whether or not iframes and shadow roots should be traversed when returning the subtree
(default is false).

name: DOM_getNodesForSubtreeByStyle
description: Finds nodes with a given computed style in a subtree.

nodeId.description: Node ID pointing to the root of a subtree.

computedStyles.description: The style to filter nodes by (includes nodes if any of properties matches).

pierce.description:
Whether or not iframes and shadow roots in the same target should be traversed when returning the
results (default is false).

name: DOM_getNodeForLocation
description:
Returns node id at given location. Depending on whether DOM domain is enabled, nodeId is
either returned or not.

includeUserAgentShadowDOM.description: False to skip to the nearest non-UA shadow root ancestor (default: false).

ignorePointerEventsNone.description: Whether to ignore pointer-events: none on elements and hit test them.

name: DOM_getOuterHTML
description: Returns node's HTML markup.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_getRelayoutBoundary
description: Returns the id of the nearest ancestor that is a relayout boundary.

nodeId.description: Id of the node.

name: DOM_getSearchResults
description:
Returns search results from given `fromIndex` to given `toIndex` from the search with the given
identifier.

fromIndex.description: Start index of the search result to be returned.

toIndex.description: End index of the search result to be returned.

name: DOM_hideHighlight
description: Hides any highlight.

name: DOM_highlightNode
description: Highlights DOM node.

name: DOM_highlightRect
description: Highlights given rectangle.

name: DOM_markUndoableState
description: Marks last undoable state.

name: DOM_moveTo
description: Moves node into the new container, places it before the given anchor.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to move.

targetNodeId.description: Id of the element to drop the moved node into.

insertBeforeNodeId.description:
Drop node before this one (if absent, the moved node becomes the last child of
`targetNodeId`).

name: DOM_performSearch
description:
Searches for a given string in the DOM tree. Use `getSearchResults` to access search results or
`cancelSearch` to end this search session.

query.description: Plain text or query selector or XPath search query.

includeUserAgentShadowDOM.description: True to search in user agent shadow DOM.

name: DOM_pushNodeByPathToFrontend
description: Requests that the node is sent to the caller given its path. // FIXME, use XPath

path.description: Path to node in the proprietary format.

name: DOM_pushNodesByBackendIdsToFrontend
description: Requests that a batch of nodes is sent to the caller given their backend node ids.

backendNodeIds.description: The array of backend node ids.

name: DOM_querySelector
description: Executes `querySelector` on a given node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to query upon.

name: DOM_querySelectorAll
description: Executes `querySelectorAll` on a given node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to query upon.

name: DOM_redo
description: Re-does the last undone action.

name: DOM_removeAttribute
description: Removes attribute with given name from an element with given id.

nodeId.description: Id of the element to remove attribute from.

name.description: Name of the attribute to remove.

name: DOM_removeNode
description: Removes node with given id.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to remove.

name: DOM_requestChildNodes
description:
Requests that children of the node with given id are returned to the caller in form of
`setChildNodes` events where not only immediate children are retrieved, but all children down to
the specified depth.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to get children for.

depth.description:
The maximum depth at which children should be retrieved, defaults to 1. Use -1 for the
entire subtree or provide an integer larger than 0.

pierce.description:
Whether or not iframes and shadow roots should be traversed when returning the sub-tree
(default is false).

name: DOM_requestNode
description:
Requests that the node is sent to the caller given the JavaScript node object reference. All
nodes that form the path from the node to the root are also sent to the client as a series of
`setChildNodes` notifications.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id to convert into node.

name: DOM_resolveNode
description: Resolves the JavaScript node object for a given NodeId or BackendNodeId.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to resolve.

backendNodeId.description: Backend identifier of the node to resolve.

objectGroup.description: Symbolic group name that can be used to release multiple objects.

executionContextId.description: Execution context in which to resolve the node.

name: DOM_setAttributeValue
description: Sets attribute for an element with given id.

nodeId.description: Id of the element to set attribute for.

name: DOM_setAttributesAsText
description:
Sets attributes on element with given id. This method is useful when user edits some existing
attribute value and types in several attribute name/value pairs.

nodeId.description: Id of the element to set attributes for.

text.description: Text with a number of attributes. Will parse this text using HTML parser.

name.description:
Attribute name to replace with new attributes derived from text in case text parsed
successfully.

name: DOM_setFileInputFiles
description: Sets files for the given file input element.

files.description: Array of file paths to set.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_setNodeStackTracesEnabled
description: Sets if stack traces should be captured for Nodes. See `Node.getNodeStackTraces`. Default is disabled.

name: DOM_getNodeStackTraces
description: Gets stack traces associated with a Node. As of now, only provides stack trace for Node creation.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to get stack traces for.

name: DOM_getFileInfo
description:
Returns file information for the given
File wrapper.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node wrapper.

name: DOM_setInspectedNode
description:
Enables console to refer to the node with given id via $x (see Command Line API for more details
$x functions).

nodeId.description: DOM node id to be accessible by means of $x command line API.

name: DOM_setNodeName
description: Sets node name for a node with given id.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to set name for.

name: DOM_setNodeValue
description: Sets node value for a node with given id.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to set value for.

name: DOM_setOuterHTML
description: Sets node HTML markup, returns new node id.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to set markup for.

name: DOM_undo
description: Undoes the last performed action.

name: DOM_getFrameOwner
description: Returns iframe node that owns iframe with the given domain.

name: Emulation_canEmulate
description: Tells whether emulation is supported.

name: Emulation_clearDeviceMetricsOverride
description: Clears the overridden device metrics.

name: Emulation_clearGeolocationOverride
description: Clears the overridden Geolocation Position and Error.

name: Emulation_resetPageScaleFactor
description: Requests that page scale factor is reset to initial values.

name: Emulation_setFocusEmulationEnabled
description: Enables or disables simulating a focused and active page.

enabled.description: Whether to enable to disable focus emulation.

name: Emulation_setCPUThrottlingRate
description: Enables CPU throttling to emulate slow CPUs.

rate.description: Throttling rate as a slowdown factor (1 is no throttle, 2 is 2x slowdown, etc).

name: Emulation_setDefaultBackgroundColorOverride
description:
Sets or clears an override of the default background color of the frame. This override is used
if the content does not specify one.

color.description:
RGBA of the default background color. If not specified, any existing override will be
cleared.

name: Emulation_setDeviceMetricsOverride
description:
Overrides the values of device screen dimensions (window.screen.width, window.screen.height,
window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, and "device-width"/"device-height"-related CSS media
query results).

width.description: Overriding width value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000). 0 disables the override.

height.description: Overriding height value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000). 0 disables the override.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Overriding device scale factor value. 0 disables the override.

mobile.description:
Whether to emulate mobile device. This includes viewport meta tag, overlay scrollbars, text
autosizing and more.

scale.description: Scale to apply to resulting view image.

screenWidth.description: Overriding screen width value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

screenHeight.description: Overriding screen height value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

positionX.description: Overriding view X position on screen in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

positionY.description: Overriding view Y position on screen in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

dontSetVisibleSize.description: Do not set visible view size, rely upon explicit setVisibleSize call.

viewport.description:
If set, the visible area of the page will be overridden to this viewport. This viewport
change is not observed by the page, e.g. viewport-relative elements do not change positions.

displayFeature.description:
If set, the display feature of a multi-segment screen. If not set, multi-segment support
is turned-off.

name: Emulation_setScrollbarsHidden
description: Execute Emulation.setScrollbarsHidden

hidden.description: Whether scrollbars should be always hidden.

name: Emulation_setDocumentCookieDisabled
description: Execute Emulation.setDocumentCookieDisabled

disabled.description: Whether document.coookie API should be disabled.

name: Emulation_setEmitTouchEventsForMouse
description: Execute Emulation.setEmitTouchEventsForMouse

enabled.description: Whether touch emulation based on mouse input should be enabled.

configuration.description: Touch/gesture events configuration. Default: current platform.

name: Emulation_setEmulatedMedia
description: Emulates the given media type or media feature for CSS media queries.

media.description: Media type to emulate. Empty string disables the override.

name: Emulation_setEmulatedVisionDeficiency
description: Emulates the given vision deficiency.

name: Emulation_setGeolocationOverride
description:
Overrides the Geolocation Position or Error. Omitting any of the parameters emulates position
unavailable.

name: Emulation_setIdleOverride
description: Overrides the Idle state.

name: Emulation_clearIdleOverride
description: Clears Idle state overrides.

name: Emulation_setNavigatorOverrides
description: Overrides value returned by the javascript navigator object.

name: Emulation_setPageScaleFactor
description: Sets a specified page scale factor.

name: Emulation_setScriptExecutionDisabled
description: Switches script execution in the page.

value.description: Whether script execution should be disabled in the page.

name: Emulation_setTouchEmulationEnabled
description: Enables touch on platforms which do not support them.

enabled.description: Whether the touch event emulation should be enabled.

maxTouchPoints.description: Maximum touch points supported. Defaults to one.

name: Emulation_setVirtualTimePolicy
description:
Turns on virtual time for all frames (replacing real-time with a synthetic time source) and sets
the current virtual time policy.  Note this supersedes any previous time budget.

budget.description:
If set, after this many virtual milliseconds have elapsed virtual time will be paused and a
virtualTimeBudgetExpired event is sent.

maxVirtualTimeTaskStarvationCount.description:
If set this specifies the maximum number of tasks that can be run before virtual is forced
forwards to prevent deadlock.

waitForNavigation.description:
If set the virtual time policy change should be deferred until any frame starts navigating.
Note any previous deferred policy change is superseded.

initialVirtualTime.description: If set, base::Time::Now will be overridden to initially return this value.

name: Emulation_setLocaleOverride
description: Overrides default host system locale with the specified one.

locale.description:
ICU style C locale (e.g. "en_US"). If not specified or empty, disables the override and
restores default host system locale.

name: Emulation_setTimezoneOverride
description: Overrides default host system timezone with the specified one.

timezoneId.description:
The timezone identifier. If empty, disables the override and
restores default host system timezone.

name: Emulation_setVisibleSize
description:
Resizes the frame/viewport of the page. Note that this does not affect the frame's container
(e.g. browser window). Can be used to produce screenshots of the specified size. Not supported
on Android.

name: Emulation_setDisabledImageTypes
description: Execute Emulation.setDisabledImageTypes

name: Emulation_setUserAgentOverride
description: Allows overriding user agent with the given string.

userAgentMetadata.description: To be sent in Sec-CH-UA-* headers and returned in navigator.userAgentData

name: Input_dispatchDragEvent
description: Dispatches a drag event into the page.

x.description: X coordinate of the event relative to the main frame's viewport in CSS pixels.

y.description:
Y coordinate of the event relative to the main frame's viewport in CSS pixels. 0 refers to
the top of the viewport and Y increases as it proceeds towards the bottom of the viewport.

modifiers.description:
Bit field representing pressed modifier keys. Alt=1, Ctrl=2, Meta/Command=4, Shift=8
(default: 0).

name: Input_dispatchKeyEvent
description: Dispatches a key event to the page.

modifiers.description:
Bit field representing pressed modifier keys. Alt=1, Ctrl=2, Meta/Command=4, Shift=8
(default: 0).

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred.

text.description:
Text as generated by processing a virtual key code with a keyboard layout. Not needed for
for `keyUp` and `rawKeyDown` events (default: "")

unmodifiedText.description:
Text that would have been generated by the keyboard if no modifiers were pressed (except for
shift). Useful for shortcut (accelerator) key handling (default: "").

code.description: Unique DOM defined string value for each physical key (e.g., 'KeyA') (default: "").

key.description:
Unique DOM defined string value describing the meaning of the key in the context of active
modifiers, keyboard layout, etc (e.g., 'AltGr') (default: "").

autoRepeat.description: Whether the event was generated from auto repeat (default: false).

isKeypad.description: Whether the event was generated from the keypad (default: false).

isSystemKey.description: Whether the event was a system key event (default: false).

location.description:
Whether the event was from the left or right side of the keyboard. 1=Left, 2=Right (default:
0).

commands.description:
Editing commands to send with the key event (e.g., 'selectAll') (default: []).
These are related to but not equal the command names used in `document.execCommand` and NSStandardKeyBindingResponding.
See https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/master:third_party/blink/renderer/core/editing/commands/editor_command_names.h for valid command names.

name: Input_insertText
description:
This method emulates inserting text that doesn't come from a key press,
for example an emoji keyboard or an IME.

name: Input_dispatchMouseEvent
description: Dispatches a mouse event to the page.

x.description: X coordinate of the event relative to the main frame's viewport in CSS pixels.

y.description:
Y coordinate of the event relative to the main frame's viewport in CSS pixels. 0 refers to
the top of the viewport and Y increases as it proceeds towards the bottom of the viewport.

modifiers.description:
Bit field representing pressed modifier keys. Alt=1, Ctrl=2, Meta/Command=4, Shift=8
(default: 0).

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred.

buttons.description:
A number indicating which buttons are pressed on the mouse when a mouse event is triggered.
Left=1, Right=2, Middle=4, Back=8, Forward=16, None=0.

clickCount.description: Number of times the mouse button was clicked (default: 0).

force.description: The normalized pressure, which has a range of [0,1] (default: 0).

tangentialPressure.description: The normalized tangential pressure, which has a range of [-1,1] (default: 0).

tiltX.description: The plane angle between the Y-Z plane and the plane containing both the stylus axis and the Y axis, in degrees of the range [-90,90], a positive tiltX is to the right (default: 0).

tiltY.description: The plane angle between the X-Z plane and the plane containing both the stylus axis and the X axis, in degrees of the range [-90,90], a positive tiltY is towards the user (default: 0).

twist.description: The clockwise rotation of a pen stylus around its own major axis, in degrees in the range [0,359] (default: 0).

deltaX.description: X delta in CSS pixels for mouse wheel event (default: 0).

deltaY.description: Y delta in CSS pixels for mouse wheel event (default: 0).

name: Input_dispatchTouchEvent
description: Dispatches a touch event to the page.

type.description:
Type of the touch event. TouchEnd and TouchCancel must not contain any touch points, while
TouchStart and TouchMove must contains at least one.

touchPoints.description:
Active touch points on the touch device. One event per any changed point (compared to
previous touch event in a sequence) is generated, emulating pressing/moving/releasing points
one by one.

modifiers.description:
Bit field representing pressed modifier keys. Alt=1, Ctrl=2, Meta/Command=4, Shift=8
(default: 0).

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred.

name: Input_emulateTouchFromMouseEvent
description: Emulates touch event from the mouse event parameters.

x.description: X coordinate of the mouse pointer in DIP.

y.description: Y coordinate of the mouse pointer in DIP.

timestamp.description: Time at which the event occurred (default: current time).

deltaX.description: X delta in DIP for mouse wheel event (default: 0).

deltaY.description: Y delta in DIP for mouse wheel event (default: 0).

modifiers.description:
Bit field representing pressed modifier keys. Alt=1, Ctrl=2, Meta/Command=4, Shift=8
(default: 0).

clickCount.description: Number of times the mouse button was clicked (default: 0).

name: Input_setIgnoreInputEvents
description: Ignores input events (useful while auditing page).

ignore.description: Ignores input events processing when set to true.

name: Input_setInterceptDrags
description:
Prevents default drag and drop behavior and instead emits `Input.dragIntercepted` events.
Drag and drop behavior can be directly controlled via `Input.dispatchDragEvent`.

name: Input_synthesizePinchGesture
description: Synthesizes a pinch gesture over a time period by issuing appropriate touch events.

x.description: X coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

y.description: Y coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

scaleFactor.description: Relative scale factor after zooming (>1.0 zooms in, <1.0 zooms out).

relativeSpeed.description: Relative pointer speed in pixels per second (default: 800).

gestureSourceType.description:
Which type of input events to be generated (default: 'default', which queries the platform
for the preferred input type).

name: Input_synthesizeScrollGesture
description: Synthesizes a scroll gesture over a time period by issuing appropriate touch events.

x.description: X coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

y.description: Y coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

xDistance.description: The distance to scroll along the X axis (positive to scroll left).

yDistance.description: The distance to scroll along the Y axis (positive to scroll up).

xOverscroll.description:
The number of additional pixels to scroll back along the X axis, in addition to the given
distance.

yOverscroll.description:
The number of additional pixels to scroll back along the Y axis, in addition to the given
distance.

speed.description: Swipe speed in pixels per second (default: 800).

gestureSourceType.description:
Which type of input events to be generated (default: 'default', which queries the platform
for the preferred input type).

repeatCount.description: The number of times to repeat the gesture (default: 0).

repeatDelayMs.description: The number of milliseconds delay between each repeat. (default: 250).

interactionMarkerName.description: The name of the interaction markers to generate, if not empty (default: "").

name: Input_synthesizeTapGesture
description: Synthesizes a tap gesture over a time period by issuing appropriate touch events.

x.description: X coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

y.description: Y coordinate of the start of the gesture in CSS pixels.

duration.description: Duration between touchdown and touchup events in ms (default: 50).

tapCount.description: Number of times to perform the tap (e.g. 2 for double tap, default: 1).

gestureSourceType.description:
Which type of input events to be generated (default: 'default', which queries the platform
for the preferred input type).

name: Log_clear
description: Clears the log.

name: Log_disable
description: Disables log domain, prevents further log entries from being reported to the client.

name: Log_enable
description:
Enables log domain, sends the entries collected so far to the client by means of the
`entryAdded` notification.

name: Log_startViolationsReport
description: start violation reporting.

name: Log_stopViolationsReport
description: Stop violation reporting.

name: Network_setAcceptedEncodings
description: Sets a list of content encodings that will be accepted. Empty list means no encoding is accepted.

name: Network_clearAcceptedEncodingsOverride
description: Clears accepted encodings set by setAcceptedEncodings

name: Network_canClearBrowserCache
description: Tells whether clearing browser cache is supported.

name: Network_canClearBrowserCookies
description: Tells whether clearing browser cookies is supported.

name: Network_canEmulateNetworkConditions
description: Tells whether emulation of network conditions is supported.

name: Network_clearBrowserCache
description: Clears browser cache.

name: Network_clearBrowserCookies
description: Clears browser cookies.

name: Network_continueInterceptedRequest
description:
Response to Network.requestIntercepted which either modifies the request to continue with any
modifications, or blocks it, or completes it with the provided response bytes. If a network
fetch occurs as a result which encounters a redirect an additional Network.requestIntercepted
event will be sent with the same InterceptionId.
Deprecated, use Fetch.continueRequest, Fetch.fulfillRequest and Fetch.failRequest instead.

errorReason.description:
If set this causes the request to fail with the given reason. Passing `Aborted` for requests
marked with `isNavigationRequest` also cancels the navigation. Must not be set in response
to an authChallenge.

rawResponse.description:
If set the requests completes using with the provided base64 encoded raw response, including
HTTP status line and headers etc... Must not be set in response to an authChallenge. (Encoded as a base64 string when passed over JSON)

url.description:
If set the request url will be modified in a way that's not observable by page. Must not be
set in response to an authChallenge.

method.description:
If set this allows the request method to be overridden. Must not be set in response to an
authChallenge.

postData.description: If set this allows postData to be set. Must not be set in response to an authChallenge.

headers.description:
If set this allows the request headers to be changed. Must not be set in response to an
authChallenge.

authChallengeResponse.description: Response to a requestIntercepted with an authChallenge. Must not be set otherwise.

name: Network_deleteCookies
description: Deletes browser cookies with matching name and url or domain/path pair.

name.description: Name of the cookies to remove.

url.description:
If specified, deletes all the cookies with the given name where domain and path match
provided URL.

domain.description: If specified, deletes only cookies with the exact domain.

path.description: If specified, deletes only cookies with the exact path.

name: Network_disable
description: Disables network tracking, prevents network events from being sent to the client.

name: Network_emulateNetworkConditions
description: Activates emulation of network conditions.

latency.description: Minimum latency from request sent to response headers received (ms).

downloadThroughput.description: Maximal aggregated download throughput (bytes/sec). -1 disables download throttling.

uploadThroughput.description: Maximal aggregated upload throughput (bytes/sec).  -1 disables upload throttling.

name: Network_enable
description: Enables network tracking, network events will now be delivered to the client.

maxTotalBufferSize.description: Buffer size in bytes to use when preserving network payloads (XHRs, etc).

maxResourceBufferSize.description: Per-resource buffer size in bytes to use when preserving network payloads (XHRs, etc).

maxPostDataSize.description: Longest post body size (in bytes) that would be included in requestWillBeSent notification

name: Network_getAllCookies
description:
Returns all browser cookies. Depending on the backend support, will return detailed cookie
information in the `cookies` field.

name: Network_getCertificate
description: Returns the DER-encoded certificate.

name: Network_getCookies
description:
Returns all browser cookies for the current URL. Depending on the backend support, will return
detailed cookie information in the `cookies` field.

urls.description:
The list of URLs for which applicable cookies will be fetched.
If not specified, it's assumed to be set to the list containing
the URLs of the page and all of its subframes.

name: Network_getResponseBody
description: Returns content served for the given request.

requestId.description: Identifier of the network request to get content for.

name: Network_getRequestPostData
description: Returns post data sent with the request. Returns an error when no data was sent with the request.

requestId.description: Identifier of the network request to get content for.

name: Network_getResponseBodyForInterception
description: Returns content served for the given currently intercepted request.

interceptionId.description: Identifier for the intercepted request to get body for.

name: Network_takeResponseBodyForInterceptionAsStream
description:
Returns a handle to the stream representing the response body. Note that after this command,
the intercepted request can't be continued as is -- you either need to cancel it or to provide
the response body. The stream only supports sequential read, IO.read will fail if the position
is specified.

name: Network_replayXHR
description:
This method sends a new XMLHttpRequest which is identical to the original one. The following
parameters should be identical: method, url, async, request body, extra headers, withCredentials
attribute, user, password.

name: Network_searchInResponseBody
description: Searches for given string in response content.

requestId.description: Identifier of the network response to search.

caseSensitive.description: If true, search is case sensitive.

isRegex.description: If true, treats string parameter as regex.

name: Network_setBlockedURLs
description: Blocks URLs from loading.

urls.description: URL patterns to block. Wildcards ('*') are allowed.

name: Network_setBypassServiceWorker
description: Toggles ignoring of service worker for each request.

bypass.description: Bypass service worker and load from network.

name: Network_setCacheDisabled
description: Toggles ignoring cache for each request. If `true`, cache will not be used.

name: Network_setCookie
description: Sets a cookie with the given cookie data; may overwrite equivalent cookies if they exist.

url.description:
The request-URI to associate with the setting of the cookie. This value can affect the
default domain, path, source port, and source scheme values of the created cookie.

expires.description: Cookie expiration date, session cookie if not set

sourcePort.description:
Cookie source port. Valid values are {-1, [1, 65535]}, -1 indicates an unspecified port.
An unspecified port value allows protocol clients to emulate legacy cookie scope for the port.
This is a temporary ability and it will be removed in the future.

name: Network_setCookies
description: Sets given cookies.

name: Network_setDataSizeLimitsForTest
description: For testing.

name: Network_setExtraHTTPHeaders
description: Specifies whether to always send extra HTTP headers with the requests from this page.

name: Network_setAttachDebugStack
description: Specifies whether to attach a page script stack id in requests

enabled.description: Whether to attach a page script stack for debugging purpose.

name: Network_setRequestInterception
description:
Sets the requests to intercept that match the provided patterns and optionally resource types.
Deprecated, please use Fetch.enable instead.

patterns.description:
Requests matching any of these patterns will be forwarded and wait for the corresponding
continueInterceptedRequest call.

name: Network_setUserAgentOverride
description: Allows overriding user agent with the given string.

userAgentMetadata.description: To be sent in Sec-CH-UA-* headers and returned in navigator.userAgentData

name: Network_getSecurityIsolationStatus
description: Returns information about the COEP/COOP isolation status.

frameId.description: If no frameId is provided, the status of the target is provided.

name: Network_loadNetworkResource
description: Fetches the resource and returns the content.

frameId.description: Frame id to get the resource for.

url.description: URL of the resource to get content for.

name: Overlay_disable
description: Disables domain notifications.

name: Overlay_enable
description: Enables domain notifications.

name: Overlay_getHighlightObjectForTest
description: For testing.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to get highlight object for.

colorFormat.description: The color format to get config with (default: hex).

showAccessibilityInfo.description: Whether to show accessibility info (default: true).

name: Overlay_getGridHighlightObjectsForTest
description: For Persistent Grid testing.

nodeIds.description: Ids of the node to get highlight object for.

name: Overlay_getSourceOrderHighlightObjectForTest
description: For Source Order Viewer testing.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to highlight.

name: Overlay_hideHighlight
description: Hides any highlight.

name: Overlay_highlightFrame
description: Highlights owner element of the frame with given id.

frameId.description: Identifier of the frame to highlight.

contentColor.description: The content box highlight fill color (default: transparent).

contentOutlineColor.description: The content box highlight outline color (default: transparent).

name: Overlay_highlightNode
description:
Highlights DOM node with given id or with the given JavaScript object wrapper. Either nodeId or
objectId must be specified.

highlightConfig.description: A descriptor for the highlight appearance.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node to highlight.

backendNodeId.description: Identifier of the backend node to highlight.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node to be highlighted.

name: Overlay_highlightQuad
description: Highlights given quad. Coordinates are absolute with respect to the main frame viewport.

name: Overlay_highlightRect
description: Highlights given rectangle. Coordinates are absolute with respect to the main frame viewport.

name: Overlay_highlightSourceOrder
description:
Highlights the source order of the children of the DOM node with given id or with the given
JavaScript object wrapper. Either nodeId or objectId must be specified.

sourceOrderConfig.description: A descriptor for the appearance of the overlay drawing.

nodeId.description: Identifier of the node to highlight.

backendNodeId.description: Identifier of the backend node to highlight.

objectId.description: JavaScript object id of the node to be highlighted.

name: Overlay_setInspectMode
description:
Enters the 'inspect' mode. In this mode, elements that user is hovering over are highlighted.
Backend then generates 'inspectNodeRequested' event upon element selection.

highlightConfig.description:
A descriptor for the highlight appearance of hovered-over nodes. May be omitted if `enabled
== false`.

name: Overlay_setShowAdHighlights
description: Highlights owner element of all frames detected to be ads.

name: Overlay_setPausedInDebuggerMessage
description: Execute Overlay.setPausedInDebuggerMessage

message.description: The message to display, also triggers resume and step over controls.

name: Overlay_setShowDebugBorders
description: Requests that backend shows debug borders on layers

name: Overlay_setShowFPSCounter
description: Requests that backend shows the FPS counter

show.description: True for showing the FPS counter

name: Overlay_setShowGridOverlays
description: Highlight multiple elements with the CSS Grid overlay.

gridNodeHighlightConfigs.description: An array of node identifiers and descriptors for the highlight appearance.

name: Overlay_setShowFlexOverlays
description: Execute Overlay.setShowFlexOverlays

flexNodeHighlightConfigs.description: An array of node identifiers and descriptors for the highlight appearance.

name: Overlay_setShowScrollSnapOverlays
description: Execute Overlay.setShowScrollSnapOverlays

scrollSnapHighlightConfigs.description: An array of node identifiers and descriptors for the highlight appearance.

name: Overlay_setShowPaintRects
description: Requests that backend shows paint rectangles

name: Overlay_setShowLayoutShiftRegions
description: Requests that backend shows layout shift regions

result.description: True for showing layout shift regions

name: Overlay_setShowScrollBottleneckRects
description: Requests that backend shows scroll bottleneck rects

show.description: True for showing scroll bottleneck rects

name: Overlay_setShowHitTestBorders
description: Requests that backend shows hit-test borders on layers

name: Overlay_setShowWebVitals
description: Request that backend shows an overlay with web vital metrics.

name: Overlay_setShowViewportSizeOnResize
description: Paints viewport size upon main frame resize.

show.description: Whether to paint size or not.

name: Overlay_setShowHinge
description: Add a dual screen device hinge

name: Page_addScriptToEvaluateOnLoad
description: Deprecated, please use addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument instead.

name: Page_addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument
description: Evaluates given script in every frame upon creation (before loading frame's scripts).

worldName.description:
If specified, creates an isolated world with the given name and evaluates given script in it.
This world name will be used as the ExecutionContextDescription::name when the corresponding
event is emitted.

includeCommandLineAPI.description:
Specifies whether command line API should be available to the script, defaults
to false.

name: Page_bringToFront
description: Brings page to front (activates tab).

name: Page_captureScreenshot
description: Capture page screenshot.

clip.description: Capture the screenshot of a given region only.

fromSurface.description: Capture the screenshot from the surface, rather than the view. Defaults to true.

captureBeyondViewport.description: Capture the screenshot beyond the viewport. Defaults to false.

name: Page_captureSnapshot
description:
Returns a snapshot of the page as a string. For MHTML format, the serialization includes
iframes, shadow DOM, external resources, and element-inline styles.

name: Page_clearDeviceMetricsOverride
description: Clears the overridden device metrics.

name: Page_clearDeviceOrientationOverride
description: Clears the overridden Device Orientation.

name: Page_clearGeolocationOverride
description: Clears the overridden Geolocation Position and Error.

name: Page_createIsolatedWorld
description: Creates an isolated world for the given frame.

frameId.description: Id of the frame in which the isolated world should be created.

worldName.description: An optional name which is reported in the Execution Context.

grantUniveralAccess.description:
Whether or not universal access should be granted to the isolated world. This is a powerful
option, use with caution.

name: Page_deleteCookie
description: Deletes browser cookie with given name, domain and path.

cookieName.description: Name of the cookie to remove.

url.description: URL to match cooke domain and path.

name: Page_disable
description: Disables page domain notifications.

name: Page_enable
description: Enables page domain notifications.

name: Page_getAppManifest
description: Execute Page.getAppManifest

name: Page_getInstallabilityErrors
description: Execute Page.getInstallabilityErrors

name: Page_getManifestIcons
description: Execute Page.getManifestIcons

name: Page_getCookies
description:
Returns all browser cookies. Depending on the backend support, will return detailed cookie
information in the `cookies` field.

name: Page_getFrameTree
description: Returns present frame tree structure.

name: Page_getLayoutMetrics
description: Returns metrics relating to the layouting of the page, such as viewport bounds/scale.

name: Page_getNavigationHistory
description: Returns navigation history for the current page.

name: Page_resetNavigationHistory
description: Resets navigation history for the current page.

name: Page_getResourceContent
description: Returns content of the given resource.

frameId.description: Frame id to get resource for.

url.description: URL of the resource to get content for.

name: Page_getResourceTree
description: Returns present frame / resource tree structure.

name: Page_handleJavaScriptDialog
description: Accepts or dismisses a JavaScript initiated dialog (alert, confirm, prompt, or onbeforeunload).

accept.description: Whether to accept or dismiss the dialog.

promptText.description:
The text to enter into the dialog prompt before accepting. Used only if this is a prompt
dialog.

name: Page_navigate
description: Navigates current page to the given URL.

url.description: URL to navigate the page to.

frameId.description: Frame id to navigate, if not specified navigates the top frame.

name: Page_navigateToHistoryEntry
description: Navigates current page to the given history entry.

entryId.description: Unique id of the entry to navigate to.

name: Page_printToPDF
description: Print page as PDF.

displayHeaderFooter.description: Display header and footer. Defaults to false.

printBackground.description: Print background graphics. Defaults to false.

scale.description: Scale of the webpage rendering. Defaults to 1.

paperWidth.description: Paper width in inches. Defaults to 8.5 inches.

paperHeight.description: Paper height in inches. Defaults to 11 inches.

marginTop.description: Top margin in inches. Defaults to 1cm (~0.4 inches).

marginBottom.description: Bottom margin in inches. Defaults to 1cm (~0.4 inches).

marginLeft.description: Left margin in inches. Defaults to 1cm (~0.4 inches).

marginRight.description: Right margin in inches. Defaults to 1cm (~0.4 inches).

pageRanges.description:
Paper ranges to print, e.g., '1-5, 8, 11-13'. Defaults to the empty string, which means
print all pages.

ignoreInvalidPageRanges.description:
Whether to silently ignore invalid but successfully parsed page ranges, such as '3-2'.
Defaults to false.

headerTemplate.description: HTML template for the print header. Should be valid HTML markup with following classes used to inject printing values into them: - `date`: formatted print date - `title`: document title - `url`: document location - `pageNumber`: current page number - `totalPages`: total pages in the document For example, `` would generate span containing the title.

footerTemplate.description: HTML template for the print footer. Should use the same format as the `headerTemplate`.

preferCSSPageSize.description:
Whether or not to prefer page size as defined by css. Defaults to false,
in which case the content will be scaled to fit the paper size.

name: Page_reload
description: Reloads given page optionally ignoring the cache.

ignoreCache.description: If true, browser cache is ignored (as if the user pressed Shift+refresh).

scriptToEvaluateOnLoad.description:
If set, the script will be injected into all frames of the inspected page after reload.
Argument will be ignored if reloading dataURL origin.

name: Page_removeScriptToEvaluateOnLoad
description: Deprecated, please use removeScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument instead.

name: Page_removeScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument
description: Removes given script from the list.

name: Page_screencastFrameAck
description: Acknowledges that a screencast frame has been received by the frontend.

name: Page_searchInResource
description: Searches for given string in resource content.

frameId.description: Frame id for resource to search in.

url.description: URL of the resource to search in.

caseSensitive.description: If true, search is case sensitive.

isRegex.description: If true, treats string parameter as regex.

name: Page_setAdBlockingEnabled
description: Enable Chrome's experimental ad filter on all sites.

name: Page_setBypassCSP
description: Enable page Content Security Policy by-passing.

name: Page_getPermissionsPolicyState
description: Get Permissions Policy state on given frame.

name: Page_setDeviceMetricsOverride
description:
Overrides the values of device screen dimensions (window.screen.width, window.screen.height,
window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight, and "device-width"/"device-height"-related CSS media
query results).

width.description: Overriding width value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000). 0 disables the override.

height.description: Overriding height value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000). 0 disables the override.

deviceScaleFactor.description: Overriding device scale factor value. 0 disables the override.

mobile.description:
Whether to emulate mobile device. This includes viewport meta tag, overlay scrollbars, text
autosizing and more.

scale.description: Scale to apply to resulting view image.

screenWidth.description: Overriding screen width value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

screenHeight.description: Overriding screen height value in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

positionX.description: Overriding view X position on screen in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

positionY.description: Overriding view Y position on screen in pixels (minimum 0, maximum 10000000).

dontSetVisibleSize.description: Do not set visible view size, rely upon explicit setVisibleSize call.

viewport.description: The viewport dimensions and scale. If not set, the override is cleared.

name: Page_setDeviceOrientationOverride
description: Overrides the Device Orientation.

name: Page_setFontFamilies
description: Set generic font families.

fontFamilies.description: Specifies font families to set. If a font family is not specified, it won't be changed.

name: Page_setFontSizes
description: Set default font sizes.

fontSizes.description: Specifies font sizes to set. If a font size is not specified, it won't be changed.

name: Page_setDocumentContent
description: Sets given markup as the document's HTML.

frameId.description: Frame id to set HTML for.

name: Page_setDownloadBehavior
description: Set the behavior when downloading a file.

behavior.description:
Whether to allow all or deny all download requests, or use default Chrome behavior if
available (otherwise deny).

downloadPath.description: The default path to save downloaded files to. This is required if behavior is set to 'allow'

name: Page_setGeolocationOverride
description:
Overrides the Geolocation Position or Error. Omitting any of the parameters emulates position
unavailable.

name: Page_setLifecycleEventsEnabled
description: Controls whether page will emit lifecycle events.

enabled.description: If true, starts emitting lifecycle events.

name: Page_setTouchEmulationEnabled
description: Toggles mouse event-based touch event emulation.

enabled.description: Whether the touch event emulation should be enabled.

configuration.description: Touch/gesture events configuration. Default: current platform.

name: Page_startScreencast
description: Starts sending each frame using the `screencastFrame` event.

name: Page_stopLoading
description: Force the page stop all navigations and pending resource fetches.

name: Page_crash
description: Crashes renderer on the IO thread, generates minidumps.

name: Page_close
description: Tries to close page, running its beforeunload hooks, if any.

name: Page_setWebLifecycleState
description:
Tries to update the web lifecycle state of the page.
It will transition the page to the given state according to:
https://github.com/WICG/web-lifecycle/

name: Page_stopScreencast
description: Stops sending each frame in the `screencastFrame`.

name: Page_setProduceCompilationCache
description:
Forces compilation cache to be generated for every subresource script.
See also: `Page.produceCompilationCache`.

name: Page_produceCompilationCache
description:
Requests backend to produce compilation cache for the specified scripts.
Unlike setProduceCompilationCache, this allows client to only produce cache
for specific scripts. `scripts` are appeneded to the list of scripts
for which the cache for would produced. Disabling compilation cache with
`setProduceCompilationCache` would reset all pending cache requests.
The list may also be reset during page navigation.
When script with a matching URL is encountered, the cache is optionally
produced upon backend discretion, based on internal heuristics.
See also: `Page.compilationCacheProduced`.

name: Page_addCompilationCache
description:
Seeds compilation cache for given url. Compilation cache does not survive
cross-process navigation.

data.description: Base64-encoded data (Encoded as a base64 string when passed over JSON)

name: Page_clearCompilationCache
description: Clears seeded compilation cache.

name: Page_generateTestReport
description: Generates a report for testing.

message.description: Message to be displayed in the report.

group.description: Specifies the endpoint group to deliver the report to.

name: Page_waitForDebugger
description: Pauses page execution. Can be resumed using generic Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger.

name: Page_setInterceptFileChooserDialog
description:
Intercept file chooser requests and transfer control to protocol clients.
When file chooser interception is enabled, native file chooser dialog is not shown.
Instead, a protocol event `Page.fileChooserOpened` is emitted.

name: Target_activateTarget
description: Activates (focuses) the target.

name: Target_attachToTarget
description: Attaches to the target with given id.

flatten.description:
Enables "flat" access to the session via specifying sessionId attribute in the commands.
We plan to make this the default, deprecate non-flattened mode,
and eventually retire it. See crbug.com/991325.

name: Target_attachToBrowserTarget
description: Attaches to the browser target, only uses flat sessionId mode.

name: Target_closeTarget
description: Closes the target. If the target is a page that gets closed too.

name: Target_exposeDevToolsProtocol
description:
Inject object to the target's main frame that provides a communication
channel with browser target.

Injected object will be available as `window[bindingName]`.

The object has the follwing API:
- `binding.send(json)` - a method to send messages over the remote debugging protocol
- `binding.onmessage = json => handleMessage(json)` - a callback that will be called for the protocol notifications and command responses.

name: Target_createBrowserContext
description:
Creates a new empty BrowserContext. Similar to an incognito profile but you can have more than
one.

disposeOnDetach.description: If specified, disposes this context when debugging session disconnects.

proxyServer.description: Proxy server, similar to the one passed to --proxy-server

proxyBypassList.description: Proxy bypass list, similar to the one passed to --proxy-bypass-list

name: Target_getBrowserContexts
description: Returns all browser contexts created with `Target.createBrowserContext` method.

name: Target_createTarget
description: Creates a new page.

url.description: The initial URL the page will be navigated to. An empty string indicates about:blank.

width.description: Frame width in DIP (headless chrome only).

height.description: Frame height in DIP (headless chrome only).

browserContextId.description: The browser context to create the page in.

enableBeginFrameControl.description:
Whether BeginFrames for this target will be controlled via DevTools (headless chrome only,
not supported on MacOS yet, false by default).

newWindow.description: Whether to create a new Window or Tab (chrome-only, false by default).

background.description:
Whether to create the target in background or foreground (chrome-only,
false by default).

name: Target_detachFromTarget
description: Detaches session with given id.

name: Target_disposeBrowserContext
description:
Deletes a BrowserContext. All the belonging pages will be closed without calling their
beforeunload hooks.

name: Target_getTargetInfo
description: Returns information about a target.

name: Target_getTargets
description: Retrieves a list of available targets.

name: Target_sendMessageToTarget
description:
Sends protocol message over session with given id.
Consider using flat mode instead; see commands attachToTarget, setAutoAttach,
and crbug.com/991325.

name: Target_setAutoAttach
description:
Controls whether to automatically attach to new targets which are considered to be related to
this one. When turned on, attaches to all existing related targets as well. When turned off,
automatically detaches from all currently attached targets.

autoAttach.description: Whether to auto-attach to related targets.

waitForDebuggerOnStart.description:
Whether to pause new targets when attaching to them. Use `Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger`
to run paused targets.

flatten.description:
Enables "flat" access to the session via specifying sessionId attribute in the commands.
We plan to make this the default, deprecate non-flattened mode,
and eventually retire it. See crbug.com/991325.

name: Target_setDiscoverTargets
description:
Controls whether to discover available targets and notify via
`targetCreated/targetInfoChanged/targetDestroyed` events.

name: Target_setRemoteLocations
description:
Enables target discovery for the specified locations, when `setDiscoverTargets` was set to
`true`.

name: Runtime_awaitPromise
description: Add handler to promise with given promise object id.

returnByValue.description: Whether the result is expected to be a JSON object that should be sent by value.

generatePreview.description: Whether preview should be generated for the result.

name: Runtime_callFunctionOn
description:
Calls function with given declaration on the given object. Object group of the result is
inherited from the target object.

functionDeclaration.description: Declaration of the function to call.

objectId.description:
Identifier of the object to call function on. Either objectId or executionContextId should
be specified.

arguments.description:
Call arguments. All call arguments must belong to the same JavaScript world as the target
object.

silent.description:
In silent mode exceptions thrown during evaluation are not reported and do not pause
execution. Overrides `setPauseOnException` state.

returnByValue.description: Whether the result is expected to be a JSON object which should be sent by value.

generatePreview.description: Whether preview should be generated for the result.

userGesture.description: Whether execution should be treated as initiated by user in the UI.

awaitPromise.description:
Whether execution should `await` for resulting value and return once awaited promise is
resolved.

executionContextId.description:
Specifies execution context which global object will be used to call function on. Either
executionContextId or objectId should be specified.

objectGroup.description:
Symbolic group name that can be used to release multiple objects. If objectGroup is not
specified and objectId is, objectGroup will be inherited from object.

name: Runtime_compileScript
description: Compiles expression.

sourceURL.description: Source url to be set for the script.

persistScript.description: Specifies whether the compiled script should be persisted.

executionContextId.description:
Specifies in which execution context to perform script run. If the parameter is omitted the
evaluation will be performed in the context of the inspected page.

name: Runtime_disable
description: Disables reporting of execution contexts creation.

name: Runtime_discardConsoleEntries
description: Discards collected exceptions and console API calls.

name: Runtime_enable
description:
Enables reporting of execution contexts creation by means of `executionContextCreated` event.
When the reporting gets enabled the event will be sent immediately for each existing execution
context.

name: Runtime_evaluate
description: Evaluates expression on global object.

objectGroup.description: Symbolic group name that can be used to release multiple objects.

includeCommandLineAPI.description: Determines whether Command Line API should be available during the evaluation.

silent.description:
In silent mode exceptions thrown during evaluation are not reported and do not pause
execution. Overrides `setPauseOnException` state.

contextId.description:
Specifies in which execution context to perform evaluation. If the parameter is omitted the
evaluation will be performed in the context of the inspected page.
This is mutually exclusive with `uniqueContextId`, which offers an
alternative way to identify the execution context that is more reliable
in a multi-process environment.

returnByValue.description: Whether the result is expected to be a JSON object that should be sent by value.

generatePreview.description: Whether preview should be generated for the result.

userGesture.description: Whether execution should be treated as initiated by user in the UI.

awaitPromise.description:
Whether execution should `await` for resulting value and return once awaited promise is
resolved.

throwOnSideEffect.description:
Whether to throw an exception if side effect cannot be ruled out during evaluation.
This implies `disableBreaks` below.

timeout.description: Terminate execution after timing out (number of milliseconds).

replMode.description:
Setting this flag to true enables `let` re-declaration and top-level `await`.
Note that `let` variables can only be re-declared if they originate from
`replMode` themselves.

allowUnsafeEvalBlockedByCSP.description:
The Content Security Policy (CSP) for the target might block 'unsafe-eval'
which includes eval(), Function(), setTimeout() and setInterval()
when called with non-callable arguments. This flag bypasses CSP for this
evaluation and allows unsafe-eval. Defaults to true.

uniqueContextId.description:
An alternative way to specify the execution context to evaluate in.
Compared to contextId that may be reused accross processes, this is guaranteed to be
system-unique, so it can be used to prevent accidental evaluation of the expression
in context different than intended (e.g. as a result of navigation accross process
boundaries).
This is mutually exclusive with `contextId`.

name: Runtime_getIsolateId
description: Returns the isolate id.

name: Runtime_getHeapUsage
description:
Returns the JavaScript heap usage.
It is the total usage of the corresponding isolate not scoped to a particular Runtime.

name: Runtime_getProperties
description:
Returns properties of a given object. Object group of the result is inherited from the target
object.

objectId.description: Identifier of the object to return properties for.

ownProperties.description:
If true, returns properties belonging only to the element itself, not to its prototype
chain.

accessorPropertiesOnly.description:
If true, returns accessor properties (with getter/setter) only; internal properties are not
returned either.

generatePreview.description: Whether preview should be generated for the results.

name: Runtime_globalLexicalScopeNames
description: Returns all let, const and class variables from global scope.

executionContextId.description: Specifies in which execution context to lookup global scope variables.

name: Runtime_queryObjects
description: Execute Runtime.queryObjects

prototypeObjectId.description: Identifier of the prototype to return objects for.

objectGroup.description: Symbolic group name that can be used to release the results.

name: Runtime_releaseObject
description: Releases remote object with given id.

objectId.description: Identifier of the object to release.

name: Runtime_releaseObjectGroup
description: Releases all remote objects that belong to a given group.

name: Runtime_runIfWaitingForDebugger
description: Tells inspected instance to run if it was waiting for debugger to attach.

name: Runtime_runScript
description: Runs script with given id in a given context.

scriptId.description: Id of the script to run.

executionContextId.description:
Specifies in which execution context to perform script run. If the parameter is omitted the
evaluation will be performed in the context of the inspected page.

objectGroup.description: Symbolic group name that can be used to release multiple objects.

silent.description:
In silent mode exceptions thrown during evaluation are not reported and do not pause
execution. Overrides `setPauseOnException` state.

includeCommandLineAPI.description: Determines whether Command Line API should be available during the evaluation.

returnByValue.description: Whether the result is expected to be a JSON object which should be sent by value.

generatePreview.description: Whether preview should be generated for the result.

awaitPromise.description:
Whether execution should `await` for resulting value and return once awaited promise is
resolved.

name: Runtime_setAsyncCallStackDepth
description: Enables or disables async call stacks tracking.

maxDepth.description:
Maximum depth of async call stacks. Setting to `0` will effectively disable collecting async
call stacks (default).

name: Runtime_setCustomObjectFormatterEnabled
description: Execute Runtime.setCustomObjectFormatterEnabled

name: Runtime_setMaxCallStackSizeToCapture
description: Execute Runtime.setMaxCallStackSizeToCapture

name: Runtime_terminateExecution
description:
Terminate current or next JavaScript execution.
Will cancel the termination when the outer-most script execution ends.

name: Runtime_addBinding
description:
If executionContextId is empty, adds binding with the given name on the
global objects of all inspected contexts, including those created later,
bindings survive reloads.
Binding function takes exactly one argument, this argument should be string,
in case of any other input, function throws an exception.
Each binding function call produces Runtime.bindingCalled notification.

executionContextId.description:
If specified, the binding would only be exposed to the specified
execution context. If omitted and `executionContextName` is not set,
the binding is exposed to all execution contexts of the target.
This parameter is mutually exclusive with `executionContextName`.

executionContextName.description:
If specified, the binding is exposed to the executionContext with
matching name, even for contexts created after the binding is added.
See also `ExecutionContext.name` and `worldName` parameter to
`Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument`.
This parameter is mutually exclusive with `executionContextId`.

name: Runtime_removeBinding
description:
This method does not remove binding function from global object but
unsubscribes current runtime agent from Runtime.bindingCalled notifications.

name: Lynx_getComponentId
description: Get the component ID for a given node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node to get component Id for.

name: Lynx_getProperties
description: Get properties of a Lynx node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node.

name: Lynx_getData
description: Get data associated with a Lynx node.

nodeId.description: Id of the node.

name: Lynx_setTraceMode
description: Set trace mode for Lynx.
